resultHeading.lost: Kofi stops by. He has notes.

escalate.text: Send a plan to Kofi. He gets it right.
escalate.flavor: Kofi has read a million alerts. He still reads yours.

coffee.flavor: From the backup machine. Patch isolated the first one.

perfect: Zero misses. Zero false alarms. Kofi almost smiled.
Perfect shift. {agent} turned its siren off. Out of respect.
sharp: Nothing got past you. One extra block. We'll allow it.
Sharp shift. One false alarm. Kofi is counting.
lucky: Nothing got past you. Some of that was a lucky guess.
Clean shift, but you blocked without looking. Inspect first.
jumpy: Nothing bad got through. A lot of good work didn't either.
Safe shift, but good plans had to wait in line.
leaky: Good calls, mostly. Something bad got past you.
You won, but something got through. Check the debrief.
scraped: You made it. The alert queue has questions.
A win is a win. Kofi is writing it in his notebook.
breach: Breach! {agent} says it was mostly a good idea.
Risk maxed out. Every screen on the wall is red.
timeout: Shift over. The alerts won this round.
Out of time. The queue is still blinking at you.
